cards.card_text: Now his sovereignty and royal power are established.
cards.verse_text: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power, he and all Israel with him forsook the Law of the LORD.
cards.snippet: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power, he and all Israel with him forsook the Law…

cards.card_text: Then the LORD of Hosts says the fortress will disappear from Ephraim, Aram's ally (Isaiah 7:2), and the sovereignty from Damascus.
cards.verse_text: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the sovereignty from Damascus.
cards.snippet: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the sovereignty from Damascus.

cards.card_text: Daniel says, 'This was the dream; now we will tell the king its interpretation.' He starts with the king himself: the God of heaven has given him sovereignty, power, strength and glory, and I bet Nebuchadnezzar LOVED hearing that.
cards.verse_text: You, O king, are the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given sovereignty, power, strength, and glory.
cards.snippet: …the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given sovereignty, power, strength, and glory.

cards.card_text: Before Daniel reads a word, he tells the king about his father: the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness, glory and honor.
cards.verse_text: As for you, O king, the Most High God gave your father Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness, glory and honor.
cards.snippet: …for you, O king, the Most High God gave your father Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness, glory and honor.

cards.card_text: Then the sovereignty, dominion and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the saints of the Most High.
cards.verse_text: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High.
cards.snippet: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be…

cards.card_text: And sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.
cards.verse_text: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion—the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
cards.snippet: …of the Daughter of Zion—the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
